title: CSI-TextBench: A Dataset and Benchmark for Language-Grounded Ambient Sensing Perception
abstract: arXiv:2610.34616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Indoor context deciphered by ambient sensing underpins many applications, from assisted living to smart buildings, yet remains weakly connected to the language-aligned paradigm of modern multimodal systems. Through billions of IoT devices, ambient WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) captures the indoor context of human activity and environmental dynamics passively via ubiquitous, always-on infrastructure. However, unlike vision or audio, CSI lacks naturally paired text like captions or transcripts, limiting its integration with language-driven AI systems.   We present CSI-TextBench, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for aligning CSI data with natural language, unifying 3 sensing benchmarks into 285,790 samples across 7 tasks and pairing them with 2,291 hierarchically structured, label-derived descriptions via many-to-many assignment to construct 2.0 million CSI-text training tuples. translated_title: CSI-TextBench：一个面向语言接地环境感知的数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 通过环境感知解读室内情境支撑着从辅助生活到智能建筑的众多应用，然而其与现代多模态系统语言对齐范式的联系仍然薄弱。借助数十亿物联网设备，环境WiFi信道状态信息（CSI）能够通过无处不在、始终在线的基础设施，被动地捕获人类活动与环境动态的室内情境。然而，与视觉或音频不同，CSI缺乏诸如字幕或转录文本等自然配对的文本，这限制了其与语言驱动AI系统的融合。我们提出了CSI-TextBench，这是一个用于将CSI数据与自然语言对齐的大规模数据集和基准，它将3个感知基准统一为涵盖7个任务的285,790个样本，并通过多对多分配方式将其与2,291个层次结构化、由标签派生的描述配对，从而构建了200万条CSI-文本训练元组。我们对来自4个范式家族的5种对齐方法进行了基准测试……
tldr: 该论文提出CSI-TextBench，这是首个将WiFi信道状态信息（CSI）环境感知数据与自然语言对齐的大规模数据集与基准，通过统一3个感知基准、7个任务共285,790个样本并配以层次化文本描述，构建了200万条CSI-文本训练元组，从而弥补CSI缺乏自然配对文本、难以融入语言驱动AI系统的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper presents CSI-TextBench, a large-scale dataset and benchmark that aligns ambient WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) with natural language, unifying 3 sensing benchmarks across 7 tasks (285,790 samples) and 2,291 hierarchically structured descriptions into 2 million CSI-text training tuples to bridge ambient sensing with language-driven AI systems.
